title: 第623章 圣天的震惊惊现神秘光芒第622章 炼化仙草突破半步天仙
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: “可惜了，没能一举突破天仙……”林轩暗自摇了摇头。
他本想借着两株天金碧叶仙草直接突破天仙境，但并未成功。
其中之一，便是他底蕴太过深厚。
普通地仙八重天的修士炼化两株天金碧叶仙草，足以直接突破到天仙境界，甚至可能连跳两三个小境界。
但林轩的根基实在太扎实了，体内混沌剑体蕴藏的潜能远超常人，每一次突破需要的能量都是普通修士的数倍、十倍乃至更多。
两株天金碧叶仙草虽然珍贵，但对他来说还不够冲破天仙的门槛。
另一个原因则是这座大墓内部的空间隔绝了外界的天道感应，无法引来天仙雷劫。
没有雷劫洗礼，就无法真正踏出那一步。
“不过半步天仙也够了。”
林轩握了握拳头，感受着体内那股浩瀚的力量，“再遇到古云武那种级别的对手，至少不会完全被动。”
虽然依旧不可能是对手，但至少有了一战之力，而不是毫无还手之力。
打不过，至少跑得掉。
他转头看向旁边的圣天。
只见那猴子此刻也正好睁开了眼睛。
金色的瞳孔中精光闪烁，浑身上下的毛发比之前更加璀璨明亮，在昏暗的洞府中散发着柔和的金色光泽，散发的气息也明显强大了不少。
“嘿嘿，天仙八重天！”
圣天咧嘴一笑，露出一口白牙，“本圣果然是天纵奇才，区区两株仙药就让本圣突破了。”
他得意地晃了晃脑袋，两条腿盘着，双手叉腰，尾巴翘得老高，那模样要多嘚瑟有多嘚瑟。
随后他看向林轩，想要炫耀一番：“小子，你怎么样，突破天仙境没有？”
然而当他看清林轩的气息时，脸上的笑容瞬间凝固了。
“呃，你怎么才半步天仙？”
圣天瞪大了眼睛，一双金色的瞳孔瞪得溜圆，嘴巴张得能塞下一个鸡蛋，一脸难以置信地看着林轩。
“你小子吃了两株天金碧叶仙草，居然才到半步天仙？！”
“本圣堂堂天仙，两株都从天仙七重天突破到八重天了，你两株下去居然都没踏出那一步……”
“你不是地仙八重天吗，按理说两株天金碧叶仙草都够任何一个地仙八重天突破到天仙了啊。”
“你这是什么情况？”
圣天整个人都不好了。
他修炼这么久，还是头一次见到这种情况。
两株在外界足以引发腥风血雨的天金碧叶仙草，居然只是让一个地仙八重天的修士提升到半步天仙？
这要是传出去，恐怕都没人敢信！
林轩摊了摊手，淡淡一笑，糊弄道：“我也不知道，大概小爷比较天才吧，呵呵。”
闻言，圣天嘴角抽搐了一下。
他上上下下打量了林轩好几遍，瞳孔中满是震惊，那种表情就像是一个穷光蛋突然看到了一座金山，既羡慕又不敢相信。
“本圣自问身为天生圣灵，底蕴已经足够深厚了，哪怕是放在整个仙界中也绝对是顶尖的那一批。”
“可跟你小子一比，本圣怎么感觉自己像个凡人呢……”
“你小子也太变态了吧！”
content_en:
"It's a pity that I couldn't break through the Celestial Immortal in one fell swoop..." Lin Xuan shook his head secretly.
He originally wanted to directly break through to the Celestial Immortal Realm with the help of two Celestial Golden Bileaf Immortal Grasses, but he failed.
One of them is that his background is too deep.
Ordinary monks in the eighth level of the Earth Immortal can refine two strains of Celestial Golden Green Leaves Immortal Grass, which is enough to directly break through to the Celestial Immortal Realm, and may even jump to two or three smaller realms in a row.
But Lin Xuan's foundation is too solid. The potential contained in the Chaos Sword Body in his body is far beyond that of ordinary people. The energy required for each breakthrough is several times, ten times or even more than that of ordinary monks.
Although two golden and blue-leaf immortal grasses were precious, they were not enough for him to break through the threshold of immortality.
Another reason is that the space inside this tomb isolates the outside world from the heavenly senses and cannot induce the thunder tribulation of heavenly beings.
Without the baptism of thunder and tribulation, one cannot truly take that step.
"But half a step to becoming an immortal is enough."
Lin Xuan clenched his fists, feeling the vast power in his body, "If we encounter an opponent of Gu Yunwu's level again, at least we won't be completely passive."
Although it is still impossible to be an opponent, at least it has the strength to fight, rather than having no ability to fight back.
If you can't beat him, you can at least run away.
He turned to look at Shengtian beside him.
I saw that the monkey just opened his eyes at this moment.
The golden pupils were shining with light, and the hair all over his body was brighter than before. It exuded a soft golden luster in the dim cave, and the aura it exuded was obviously much stronger.
"Hey, hey, the eighth level of heaven!"
Shengtian grinned, showing his white teeth, "I am indeed a genius. Just two fairy medicines allowed me to break through."
He shook his head proudly, with his legs crossed, his hands on his hips, and his tail raised high, as if he was as cocky as he was.
Then he looked at Lin Xuan, wanting to show off: "Boy, how are you? Have you broken through to the Immortal Realm?"
However, when he saw Lin Xuan's aura clearly, the smile on his face froze instantly.
"Uh, how come you are only half a god?"
Shengtian's eyes widened, his golden pupils rounded, his mouth wide enough to fit an egg in, and he looked at Lin Xuan in disbelief.
"You kid ate two golden-leaf fairy grasses and you're only half-way to becoming a fairy?!"
"Both of my Holy Celestial Immortals have broken through from the Seventh Heaven to the Eighth Heaven. You two fell down and you didn't even take that step..."
"Aren't you the eighth-level earthly immortal? It stands to reason that two golden-leaf fairy grasses are enough for any eighth-level earthly immortal to break through to the level of heavenly immortal."
"What's going on with you?"
Shengtian's whole body was in bad shape.
This is the first time he has seen this situation after practicing for so long.
Two golden and blue-leaf fairy grasses that are enough to cause chaos in the outside world actually only allowed an eighth-level earthly immortal monk to be promoted to a half-step heavenly immortal?
If this were spread, no one would dare to believe it!
Lin Xuan spread his hands, smiled faintly, and said confusedly: "I don't know, maybe I am a genius, haha."
Hearing this, the corner of Shengtian's mouth twitched.
He looked Lin Xuan up and down several times, his pupils full of shock. His expression was like that of a pauper who suddenly saw a golden mountain, envious and unbelievable.
"I think that as a born Holy Spirit, my background is deep enough. Even if I am placed in the entire fairy world, I am definitely one of the top ones."
"But compared with your kid, why do I feel like a mortal..."
"You kid is too perverted!"
